title: Intel’s stock crashes, knocking $12B from government’s stake
hook_text: Intel just lost twelve billion dollars.
script:
Intel just lost twelve billion dollars from the government stake.
The massive stock crash erases twelve billion dollars as market pressures mount.
The AI industry gobbles up memory and other essential hardware components.
High demand drives component prices up across the global market.
Rising component costs cause personal computer prices to increase sharply.
Declining personal computer sales are directly hurting Intel business operations.
